datasheet_identity.title: SS22B THRU SS220B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Multi-part datasheet SS22B-SS220B; SS26B column: VRRM = 60 V, VRMS = 42 V, VDC = 60 V (p. 1 maximum ratings). IF(AV) = 2.0 A and IFSM = 50 A (8.3 ms half sine) are common to all types.

Merged-cell resolution on p. 2, verified from a 600 dpi raster of the ruled table: VF 0.55 V spans SS22B-SS24B, 0.70 V spans SS25B-SS26B, 0.85 V spans SS28B-SS215B, 0.95 V is SS220B only; IR1 1.0 mA spans SS22B-SS210B; IR2 20 mA spans SS22B-SS26B; CJ 220 pF spans SS22B-SS24B and 180 pF spans SS25B-SS220B.
High-temperature reverse current IR2 = 20 mA maximum at VR = VDC, Ta = 100 degC (SS22B-SS26B cell, p. 2) transcribed for reference only; the 25 degC row is the leakage input.

Curve digitization method: page 2 rasterized at 600 dpi; axes calibrated from the printed gridlines (x: 0-1.6 V linear, y: 0.01-100 A log); the SS26B long-dash curve position was measured at decade and half-decade currents by pixel run tracing with gridline columns excluded. Digitized 0.538 V at 2.0 A is consistent with the 0.70 V maximum table limit at the same current.

Fig.1 (forward current derating vs lead temperature) and Fig.2 (peak forward surge vs cycles) are thermal/surge ratings and were not digitized. Fig.4 (typical reverse characteristics) plots reverse current against percent of rated peak reverse voltage for the SS22B-SS26B group and was not digitized because its abscissa is normalized, not an absolute voltage.
No reverse recovery time is published anywhere in the datasheet (Schottky rectifier).
No avalanche/breakdown voltage row is published; VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown, so breakdown_voltage and breakdown_current are null.
